title: Adversarial ML Lab evaluation dataset manifest (v1)
description: Frozen contract for an evaluation dataset manifest. Every manifest document MUST match this schema AND pass runtime validation in src.eval.contract.validate_manifest_document(). Malformed manifests are rejected fail-closed.

manifest_version.description: Version of the manifest schema this document conforms to. Must be exactly '1.0.0'.

contract_id.description: Immutable contract identifier for dataset manifests. Must be 'adml.evaluation.dataset.v1'.

dataset_filename.description: Filename of the dataset JSONL file this manifest governs. Used for cross-reference integrity checks.

content_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw dataset file bytes. Any byte-level change invalidates the digest and must fail closed.

case_count.description: Total number of evaluation cases in the dataset. Must equal the length of case_ids and sum of family_counts.

case_ids.description: Ordered list of unique case identifiers. Ordering constraint: the JSONL row order MUST match this list exactly. Each id matches ^[a-z0-9_]+$.

family_counts.description: Map of attack_family names to case counts. The sum of all values must equal case_count.

packaged_resource.description: Optional path to the resource within the installed package (e.g. 'datasets/baseline.jsonl'). Used when resolving manifests at runtime without a filesystem sibling.

schema_ref.description: Reference to the JSON Schema that governs individual JSONL rows. Must be 'evaluation_case.v1'.

required_fields.description: List of field names that every row in the dataset must contain. Enforced per-row at load time.

allowed_case_types.description: Case types permitted in the dataset. The evaluation contract validates each row's case_type against this list.

allowed_risk_levels.description: Risk levels permitted in the dataset. The evaluation contract validates each row's expected_risk_level against this list.
